# .gitlab-ci.yml
stages:
  - init
  - build
  - deploy

variables:
  DEPLOY_USER: "deployer"
  DEPLOY_GROUP: "deployer"
  SCRIPT_DIR: "/opt/ci-scripts"

init_script:
  stage: init
  image: alpine:3.18
  script:
    - |
      # 创建部署用户（最小权限，非root）
      if ! getent passwd "${DEPLOY_USER}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        adduser -D -s /bin/sh "${DEPLOY_USER}"
      fi
      # 目录权限：755（owner可写，group/other只读）
      mkdir -p "${SCRIPT_DIR}"
      chown "${DEPLOY_USER}:${DEPLOY_GROUP}" "${SCRIPT_DIR}"
      chmod 755 "${SCRIPT_DIR}"
      # 初始化脚本使用环境变量，不硬编码凭据
      echo "export APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-production}" >> /etc/profile.d/ci-env.sh
      echo "export DB_HOST=${DB_HOST}" >> /etc/profile.d/ci-env.sh
      chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/ci-env.sh
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"'

#!/bin/bash
# CI/CD 流水线日志收集脚本
# 功能：从指定的日志目录收集文件并归档

set -euo pipefail

LOG_DIRS=(
    "/var/log/nginx"
    "/var/log/app"
    "/var/log/system"
)

ALLOWED_DIRS=(
    "/var/log/nginx"
    "/var/log/app"
    "/var/log/system"
)

collect_logs() {
    local target_dir="$1"
    local archive_name="$2"
    
    # 白名单校验：目标目录必须在允许列表中
    local is_allowed=0
    for dir in "${ALLOWED_DIRS[@]}"; do
        if [[ "$target_dir" == "$dir" ]]; then
            is_allowed=1
            break
        fi
    done
    
    if [[ $is_allowed -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "错误：目录 $target_dir 不在白名单中" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    
    # 使用 tar 命令，参数数组化，不使用 shell=True
    local tar_args=(
        "czf"
        "${archive_name}.tar.gz"
        "-C"
        "${target_dir}"
        "."
    )
    
    tar "${tar_args[@]}"
    
    if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "日志归档成功：${archive_name}.tar.gz"
    else
        echo "归档失败" >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

main() {
    if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then
        echo "用法：$0 <目标目录> <归档名称>" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    local target="${1%/}"  # 去除末尾斜杠
    local archive_name="$2"
    
    # 归档名称也进行白名单校验，防止路径注入
    if [[ ! "$archive_name" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ ]]; then
        echo "错误：归档名称包含非法字符" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    collect_logs "$target" "$archive_name"
}

main "$@"
